test_cases.path_step: End video session and log out
test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 5: Participating in a Live Class
test_cases.test_case_title: Student ends video session and logs out
test_cases.pre_condition: A student is logged in and actively participating in a live video session. The teacher has granted intervention permission to the student, and the student's audio/video is being broadcast. The session has concluded, and the student needs to exit the session.
test_cases.expected_result: The student's video session participation is terminated. The student's session is securely ended, and they are redirected to the 'Landing Page'. All temporary authentication data is cleared, and the system notifies the user of successful logout.
test_cases.post_condition: The student is logged out of the system and is on the Landing Page. The video session for the student has ended.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Exit' button to leave the video session.
Click the 'Logout' button in the navigation bar.

test_cases.groups_involved: End Video Session, Open Side Menu, Send Chat Message, Request to Speak, Grant Student Intervention
